title: [Extensibility Request] issue 30339: add OnAfterCalcAvailableQtyBase event to Whse. Worksheet Line
summary: An integration event was added to the warehouse worksheet line calculation to allow extensions to adjust the available quantity after the standard calculation completes.
key_points: New OnAfterCalcAvailableQtyBase event enables extensions to modify calculated available quantity
Eliminates the need for extensions to reimplement entire CalcAvailableQtyBase logic
Supports scenarios like stock ring-fencing that require tweaking results based on standard calculation
Event is raised at the end of CalcAvailableQtyBase procedure with calculated AvailableQty parameter
Complements the existing OnBeforeCalcAvailableQtyBase event with post-calculation flexibility
